answer: Bind each identity to one distinct registered vehicle, verified by its VIN and plate against the motor registry each epoch and kept legal with paid insurance and a passed inspection. One VIN anchors one identity, like a single oasis cannot be claimed by two caravans. A farm must buy, insure and maintain a real car per fake; a rusting relic on shale still costs tax and storage, so a thousand sybils need a thousand vehicles.
